    <p class="attributed-text-segment-list__content text-color-text !text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap break-words
        " dir="ltr" data-test-id="main-feed-activity-card__commentary">At RenewBuy, employee wellbeing isn’t a checkbox, it’s a commitment👁️💙

On 8th January, we took a step toward prioritizing preventive healthcare by organizing a free medical eye check-up and doctor’s consultation for our employees, in collaboration with the Cure Path team. From vision screenings to expert guidance, the initiative aimed to encourage early detection, awareness, and healthier lifestyle choices.

We were heartened to see 60+ employees actively participate, taking time out to focus on their health amidst busy work schedules. Moments like these remind us that small initiatives can create meaningful impact—when employees feel cared for, supported, and empowered to look after their wellbeing.

As we continue to build a people-first culture, we remain committed to creating more such opportunities that promote holistic health and long-term wellness for our teams.

Here’s to clearer vision, healthier choices, and a workplace that truly cares. ✨
